Reports may have any type, including an infinite sequence. No exact classifier from those same data exists. A nonconstant Boolean-input integer fixture witnesses identical complete readings with zero versus nonzero bias, distinct signal values at both inputs and different supplied true anchors. These are model-class guarantees, not claims that fallible justification or all infinitist explanations fail.
